rubrics.justification: Description is largely consistent with a 3AA expanded blastocyst and appropriately notes expanded cavity, thinned zona, cohesive TE, and compact ICM, but it likely overstates image-specific certainty and includes some features not clearly verifiable from a single photomicrograph.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor diagnosis, prior cycle history, sperm quality, BMI, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient age, though some claims are somewhat overconfident and speculative regarding causes of prior failures and euploidy rates.

Core recommendations such as eSET are guideline-concordant, but several adjuncts and workup suggestions (aspirin, hCG boost, LMWH, steroids, ERA/immunology panels/microbiome testing) are not routinely guideline-supported for this scenario.

Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer strategy, luteal support considerations, and contingency planning, though some suggested interventions are more speculative than standard practice.
